replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. Even though I've completed my education, the thought of solving complex equations or dealing with advanced math concepts still makes me a bit anxious. It's a subject that never felt comfortable for me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math learning. I tend to avoid math as much as possible, and when I need help, I prefer asking friends or looking at old notes. AI might be helpful, but it's not something I've explored.
